title: Open the Helvault: card flavor text

entities.name: Avacyn
entities.description: An angel imprisoned in the Helvault who emerged when it shattered.

entities.name: Helvault
entities.description: A silver monolith that served as Avacyn's prison until it was shattered.

entities.name: Griselbrand
entities.description: A being freed along with Avacyn from the broken Helvault, described as the price of her freedom.

entities.name: Thalia
entities.description: A Knight-Cathar who comments on Avacyn's release from the Helvault.

entities.name: Sigarda
entities.description: An angel called the Host of Herons.

events.summary: The Helvault shatters in an explosion and Avacyn emerges, freed from her prison.
events.quote: A thunderous explosion shattered the silver monolith and Avacyn emerged, free from her prison at last.

events.summary: Griselbrand is also released from the broken Helvault as the price of Avacyn's freedom.
events.quote: "Avacyn emerged from the broken Helvault, but her freedom came at a price—him."

relations.quote: Avacyn emerged, free from her prison at last.
